headline: On November 16, 1974: Arecibo message sent to M13
captionCards: First interstellar message as a demonstration of tech
instagramCaption:
The Arecibo message was broadcast from Puerto Rico.

A radio signal carrying human and Earth data was sent toward Messier 13 in 1974.
It included numbers, DNA structure, and a human figure.
Traveling at light speed, it will reach M13 in about 25,000 years.
This remains a symbolic milestone in humanity’s attempt to share its existence with the cosmos.
